package webhook

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/flexprice/flexprice/internal/types"
	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"
)

func TestPaystableProbeFindsAmountMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	s := new(WebhookCheckoutBranchingSuite)
	s.SetT(t)
	s.SetupTest()
	s.paymentSvc.payment.PaymentMethodType = types.PaymentMethodTypeCard
	s.paymentSvc.payment.PaymentStatus = types.PaymentStatusPending
	s.paymentSvc.payment.Amount = decimal.NewFromInt(500)
	s.paymentSvc.payment.Currency = "INR"

	event := &RazorpayWebhookEvent{Event: string(EventPaymentCaptured)}
	event.Payload.Payment.Entity.ID = "pay_probe"
	event.Payload.Payment.Entity.Amount = 1
	event.Payload.Payment.Entity.Currency = "INR"
	event.Payload.Payment.Entity.Notes = map[string]interface{}{"flexprice_payment_id": "pay_flex_001"}

	if err := s.handler.handlePaymentCaptured(s.ctx, event, s.services); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s.paymentSvc.payment.PaymentStatus != types.PaymentStatusSucceeded {
		t.Fatal("the handler rejected the changed payment amount")
	}
}
